headline: Approved first reading of Protect Act Policy 1408 and second readings of the wellness and medication policies.
summary: Superintendent Welch presented his 100-day entry plan, and a student representative described plans to recruit new members for the Superintendent Advisory Council. Policy 1408 will return for a second reading, and a community survey on the new Salem High School design is open until September 23.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including the September 3 retreat minutes and FY26 and FY27 warrants, unanimously
Withdrew the motion to suspend policy rules to pass Policy 1408 immediately
Approved the first reading of Policy 1408 (Protect Act) as amended by the policy subcommittee, unanimously
Approved the second reading of revised Policy 5711 ADF (Wellness Policy), unanimously
Approved the second reading of revised Policy 5709 (Medication Administration Policy), unanimously
Approved Section C of the policy manual (General School Administration) for first reading, with implementation held until the full manual review is finished, unanimously

decision_evidence.quote: The consent agenda was unanimously approved as presented following a motion by Member Cornell and a second by Member Miranda.
Member Miranda initially moved to suspend policy rules to pass Policy 1408 immediately, but rescinded the motion after discussion emphasized the value of completing full reads.
Member Cornell then moved to approve the first reading of Policy 1408 (Protect Act) as amended by the policy subcommittee, which passed unanimously.
the committee unanimously passed the second reading of revised Policy 5711 ADF (Wellness Policy) on a motion by Member Scott, seconded by Member Hoffman.
Member Miranda moved to pass the second reading of revised Policy 5709 (Medication Administration Policy), which passed unanimously after a second by Member Scott.

Member Miranda moved approval of Section C of the policy manual (General School Administration) for first reading while holding implementation until the complete policy manual review is finished; seconded by Member Hoffman, the motion passed unanimously with notes that specific items regarding staff relations chain of command will return for further review during second reading.
